name: Market timing
meaning: How strongly 2026–27 agent adoption creates demand now

name: Pain severity
meaning: How costly or blocking the problem is for autonomous agents/operators

name: Willingness to pay
meaning: Likelihood of enterprise/platform/API buyers paying recurring or usage fees

name: API-native fit
meaning: Can it be consumed as a narrow reusable machine dependency

name: Competitive whitespace
meaning: How much room remains after incumbents/standards

name: Defensibility
meaning: Historical data, network effects, verification data, integrations, trust

name: Solo MVP buildability
meaning: Can a highly technical small team ship a useful wedge quickly

name: Expansion upside
meaning: Ability to grow into a broader infrastructure control point
